name: blasito
description: Local-first text expander for Chromium and Firefox: type a shortcut, get your saved text.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && cp src/shared/fonts/*.txt dist/ && node scripts/build-firefox.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && rm -f blasito-*.zip && (cd dist && zip -qr ../blasito-chrome.zip .) && (cd dist-firefox && zip -qr ../blasito-firefox.zip .) && git archive --format=zip -o blasito-source.zip HEAD
